-97.34680,32.73190.name: Fort Worth Fertility, PA
-97.34680,32.73190.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-53.48441,-24.96063.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: ginoferty.com. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

-84.24000,34.04890.name: Society for Assisted Reproductive Technology
-84.24000,34.04890.desc: Collects and publishes US clinic outcome data alongside the CDC's, and sets much of the professional guidance the sector follows in the absence of law — including the voluntary family limits for donors. Success rates published per clinic create an incentive that shapes practice: a clinic can improve its numbers by treating easier patients, and the published figure cannot distinguish that from better medicine. The clinic-by-clinic reports themselves are published at sartcorsonline.com, separately from the society's own site.

144.98000,-37.82000.name: Monash IVF
144.98000,-37.82000.desc: An Australian fertility group, publicly listed, which has faced litigation and regulatory scrutiny over embryo handling errors including embryos transferred to the wrong patient. Listed ownership means these failures appear in disclosures and share prices as well as in clinical records, which is more visibility than most of this sector produces.

-78.82000,42.95500.name: 22nd Century Group
-78.82000,42.95500.state: Buffalo, New York — 321 Farmington Road, Mocksville
-78.82000,42.95500.desc: Engineers tobacco with very low nicotine, authorised by the FDA as a modified risk tobacco product in 2021. An engineered plant approved specifically because it removes an addictive compound — the only case on this map of a modification whose purpose is to make a product less effective at what it does.
